description: Search public opportunities, vendors, awards, exclusions, or reference collections. Results include provenance and a generation-pinned cursor.

collection.description: Public collection name, such as opportunities, vendors, awards, exclusions, or naics.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding search page.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, from 1 to 50.

q.description: Plain-language search terms; empty lists the selected collection.

name: search

JsonObject.description: Source-specific JSON map. The envelope is stable; map keys vary by official source.

data.description: Source-specific fields, including provenance and official identifiers.

id.description: Stable identifier for a record in this generation.

summary.description: Short searchable text, when returned by this operation.

url.description: Public canonical path for the record.

collection.description: Collection searched, such as opportunities or awards.

coverage_url.description: Public source-date endpoint, when this collection supplies it.

generation.description: UUID of the snapshot used for every result on this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

title: Search federal records
